name: Replication lag on replica reads
description: All reads go to the two database replicas. About 300 ms after the primary finishes a write, the write reaches the replicas, so a fresh write read from a replica can be stale (replication lag). Try setting the max replica lag to 200 ms: replicas that are too far behind stop taking reads and the primary takes them instead. Stale reads drop, but the primary gets busier.
